quests.instruction: Select the most cohesive and reflective journal entry incorporating target vocabulary.
quests.prompt: Write one sentence about two things you did this afternoon, joined with 'and'.
options: I ran a few errands and picked up groceries on my way back from work.
I did the task today and then I was done with everything on my list.
Morning time was happening so things were like that yesterday.
Because the schedule was crowded, nothing.
quests.correctAnswer: I ran a few errands and picked up groceries on my way back from work.
quests.hint: Find the entry that weaves the target tokens into a complete thought with clear setting, action, and personal reflection.
quests.explanation: "And" links two related actions into a single flowing sentence instead of two short, choppy ones.
